definition.method: Execute a stochastic variance measurement across 10,000 trials for both baseline and feedback_enabled conditions. Calculate normalized variance of action probabilities per state-step, filtering for memory-access events to ensure the variance measurement reflects preference drift rather than random noise.
definition.stop: Terminate after 3 seeds are processed or if variance metrics converge.
definition.success: The experiment succeeds if the normalized variance of action probabilities in the feedback_enabled condition is statistically significantly lower (p < 0.05) than the baseline condition.
